# Field Treatment
## Wound selection
1. Select a body region on the targeting doll. 2. Use the item on the patient. 3. In [color=#58e6d9]Automatic[/color] mode, the server selects the most dangerous suitable external wound. 4. Check the result with an analyzer or in the [color=#58e6d9]Wounds[/color] tab.
## Direct pressure
- Item: empty hand. - Use: click the patient with external bleeding. - Result: temporarily reduces the flow of the selected wound.
## Bandage
- Item: [color=#58e6d9]Gauze[/color]. - Application area: external wound. - Result: controls capillary and venous flow; reduces arterial flow. - State: the bandage has sterility and absorbency that is consumed by blood.
## Hemostatic pack
- Item: [color=#58e6d9]Brutepack[/color]. - Application area: deep external wound. - Result: stronger local hemostasis.
## Tourniquet
- Item: [color=#58e6d9]Tourniquet[/color]. - Application area: arm or leg. - Result: blocks external sources below the selected area. - State: stores application time, ischemia onset, and critical ischemia. - Removal: prepare bandage, hemostatic, and blood replenishment, then remove it in a controlled manner.
## Splint
- Item: [color=#58e6d9]NCFieldSplint[/color]. - Application area: limb with a fracture. - Result: increases bone stability and reduces secondary damage from movement.
External blood loss reduces the actual [color=#58e6d9]bloodstream[/color] solution. Once the source is controlled, check blood volume and perfusion.
